feature_name: Fix chain/callback dispatch on dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks
description: Fix a bug where acks_late with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks caused chains/callbacks to be permanently lost when a worker crashed after storing SUCCESS but before the broker ack.
functional_requirements: Dispatch pending chain/callbacks on the dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks
Preserve existing dedup behavior for tasks without chains
Add integration tests for chain dispatch on redelivery
Add unit tests for the trace module changes
